annotation.title_clean: Council Directive 93/44/EEC of 14 June 1993 amending Directive 89/392/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to machinery
annotation.title_en: Council Directive 93/44/EEC of 14 June 1993 amending Directive 89/392/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 175
annotation.summary_en: Council Directive 93/44/EEC amends the original EU Machinery Directive 89/392/EEC. It extends coverage to safety components placed on the market separately and adds essential health and safety requirements for machinery lifting or moving persons. It also revises CE marking, declarations of conformity, notified body procedures and Annex IV.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends the Machinery Directive to safety components placed on the market separately, with an EC declaration of conformity.
Adds Section 6 essential requirements for machinery lifting or moving persons, such as doubled working coefficients and anti-fall measures.
Adds emergency stop, trapping and slipping hazard requirements to Annex I.
Machinery with CE marking and a declaration of conformity is presumed conforming; harmonized standards give a presumption of conformity.
Member States must transpose by 1 July 1994 and apply the rules from 1 January 1995.
